summary: Describes how Microsoft Internet Explorer and IIS in Windows 2000 use Kerberos, and fall back to NTLM, to secure web transactions. It defines the HTTP authentication scheme named negotiate, which wraps SPNEGO. It documents existing practice and is informational.

eli5.summary: A browser and a website agree on the safest way to prove who you are, such as a ticket from your company login, and fall back to an older way if needed.
